metadata.name: holdback
metadata.description: HOLDBACK: every Solana payment gets an undo window enforced on-chain

instructions.name: close_hold
docs: Closes a released or reclaimed hold and refunds its rent.

instructions.name: create_hold
docs: Places `amount` of an SPL / Token-2022 token in a new hold.

instructions.name: create_hold_sol
docs: Places `amount` lamports in a new hold.

instructions.name: extend_window
docs: Oracle-only: lengthens a pending hold's window and raises its tier.

instructions.name: flag_subject
docs: Records one scam report about `subject`. One per reporter per subject.

accounts.name: flag
docs: `init` makes a second flag by the same reporter fail.

instructions.name: init_deposit_box
docs: Creates a deposit box for `owner` and its token account for `mint`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The owner or the relayer; whoever pays the rent.

accounts.name: owner
docs: a box for someone grants the creator nothing.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Creates the singleton config. Only the program's upgrade authority can
call this, and only once.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority, so nobody can front-run the
deployer and install their own service keys.

instructions.name: instant_transfer
docs: Zero-window path: pays a recipient the sender has marked as trusted
directly, with no vault. Requires the `Trust` PDA to exist.

accounts.name: trust
docs: Proof that the sender trusts this recipient. Without it the account
fails to deserialize and the transfer is refused.

instructions.name: instant_transfer_sol
docs: Zero-window path for native SOL.

instructions.name: open_hold_from_deposit
docs: Relayer-only: moves tokens from the owner's deposit box into a new
hold whose sender is the box owner.

accounts.name: deposit_box
docs: The hold's sender is read from here, never from instruction data.

instructions.name: reclaim
docs: Undo: returns a pending token hold to the sender before `release_at`.

accounts.name: sender_token
docs: The refund destination: any token account of this mint that the
hold's sender owns. No signer can point it anywhere else.

instructions.name: reclaim_sol
docs: Undo for a native SOL hold.

instructions.name: release
docs: Permissionless crank: pays the recipient once the window is over.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone for `release`; the sender for `release_early`. Pays for the
recipient's token account if it does not exist yet.

instructions.name: release_early
docs: Sender-only: pays the recipient before the window is over.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone for `release`; the sender for `release_early`. Pays for the
recipient's token account if it does not exist yet.

instructions.name: release_early_sol
docs: Sender-only early release of a native SOL hold.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone for `release_sol`; the sender for `release_early_sol`.

instructions.name: release_sol
docs: Permissionless crank for a native SOL hold.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone for `release_sol`; the sender for `release_early_sol`.

instructions.name: remove_trust
docs: Removes the signer's trust in `recipient` and refunds the rent.

instructions.name: set_trust
docs: Marks `recipient` as trusted by the signer.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin-only update of service keys, window limits and the pause switch.

instructions.name: withdraw_deposit
docs: Returns tokens from a deposit box to its owner. Owner or relayer signs.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The box owner, or the relayer acting for them.

accounts.name: owner_token
docs: Whoever signs, the money can only land in a token account owned by
the box owner.

errors.name: WindowTooLong
errors.msg: The undo window is longer than the maximum this program allows

errors.name: WindowTooShort
errors.msg: The undo window is shorter than the minimum this program allows

errors.name: WindowCannotShrink
errors.msg: An undo window can be extended but never shortened

errors.name: HoldNotPending
errors.msg: This hold has already been released or reclaimed

errors.name: WindowNotOver
errors.msg: The undo window is still running; funds cannot be released yet

errors.name: WindowOver
errors.msg: The undo window has ended; this action is no longer possible

errors.name: NotTrusted
errors.msg: The sender has not marked this recipient as trusted

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: This signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: New holds are paused; existing holds can still be reclaimed or released

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: The amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: The token mint does not match this hold

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InvalidTier
errors.msg: The risk tier is not a known value

errors.name: TierCannotDrop
errors.msg: The risk tier can be raised but never lowered

errors.name: InvalidWindowConfig
errors.msg: Window settings must satisfy min <= default <= max <= 30 days

errors.name: SelfTransfer
errors.msg: Sender and recipient must be different accounts

errors.name: InvalidReason
errors.msg: The flag reason code is not a known value

errors.name: HoldStillPending
errors.msg: This hold is still pending and cannot be closed

errors.name: NotTokenHold
errors.msg: This hold holds native SOL; use the SOL instruction

errors.name: NotSolHold
errors.msg: This hold holds tokens; use the token instruction

errors.name: UnsupportedMint
errors.msg: Mints that take a fee on transfer are not supported

errors.name: AmountBelowRentFloor
errors.msg: The amount is too small to keep the recipient account rent-exempt

errors.name: WrongParty
errors.msg: The account does not belong to the expected party

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton program configuration. Seeds: `["config"]`.

fields.name: admin
docs: May update this account. Set to the program's upgrade authority at init.

fields.name: relayer
docs: Service key that may act for deposit-box owners, within the limits
enforced by `open_hold_from_deposit`, `withdraw_deposit` and `reclaim`.

fields.name: risk_oracle
docs: Service key that may extend (never shorten) a pending hold's window.

fields.name: min_window_secs
docs: Shortest window a hold may have. `0` enables the trusted instant path.

fields.name: default_window_secs
docs: Window used when nothing is known about the recipient. Also the floor
for holds opened by the relayer from a deposit box.

fields.name: max_window_secs
docs: Longest window a hold may ever reach, measured from `created_at`.

fields.name: paused
docs: Emergency stop for new holds. Reclaim, release and close keep working.

types.name: DepositBox
docs: A program-owned inbox for a wallet that cannot sign program instructions
itself (a seedless embedded wallet). The owner sends tokens to the box's
associated token account; the relayer can then only return them to the
owner or open a hold whose sender is the owner. Seeds: `["box", owner]`.

types.name: Flag
docs: One scam report by one reporter about one subject.
Seeds: `["flag", reporter, subject]`, so a reporter can flag a subject once.

types.name: Hold
docs: One protected payment. Seeds: `["hold", sender, nonce_le_u64]`.
Token holds keep the funds in an associated token account owned by this
PDA. SOL holds keep the lamports in this account itself, above rent.

fields.name: sender
docs: Who paid and who alone can get the money back before `release_at`.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Who receives the money once the window is over.

fields.name: mint
docs: Token mint, or [`NATIVE_SOL_MINT`] for a SOL hold.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount held, in the mint's base units (lamports for SOL).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix time the hold was created.

fields.name: release_at
docs: Unix time from which anyone may release the funds to the recipient.

fields.name: tier
docs: Risk tier, see [`crate::constants::tier`].

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: sha256 of the canonical evidence JSON that justified the window.

fields.name: origin
docs: See [`crate::constants::origin`].

fields.name: status
docs: See [`crate::constants::status`].

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Paid the rent for this account and its vault; gets it back on close.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Sender-chosen nonce that makes the PDA unique.

fields.name: early
docs: True when the sender released before the window ended.

types.name: SubjectStats
docs: On-chain reputation of an address as a payment recipient.
Seeds: `["stats", subject]`.
`holds_reclaimed_against` counts how often senders pulled money back from
this address. The risk agent reads it as a scam signal.

types.name: Trust
docs: "The sender trusts this recipient". Existence is the whole signal.
Seeds: `["trust", sender, recipient]`.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Fields left as `None` keep their current value.
